messages.subject: Distance install problems
parts:
Distance-list:

Nearly 100 people have downloaded Distance 4.1, but I have one report of a
possible install problem (below) - which looks like it's due to a sick computer,
not to the install package. However, just to make sure: can anyone else who has
had any problems installing the program please contact me. Thanks,

- Len

Subject: Re: Program Distance Question (fwd)
To: "Len Thomas" <l...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk>
From: "Scott Somershoe" <ssome...@usgs.gov>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2003 11:15:14 -0600


Len,
Thanks for the help. I've spent a little time working with it, but I
downloaded the new Distance 4.1 and it is having all kinds of problems. I
download it from the Distance page and opened the d41setup.exe file and it
started program MARK. The third time I tried it started Distance, but it
had a problem with a file and never opened (said installation problem).
The fourth time it worked and I opened the file you sent, but then it
crashed and Distance won't reopen. My one day in the office this week
(been bird banding) and my computer is acting up horribly. Not just with
Distance, but Internet explorer, etc. Frustrating. Thanks again and I'm
sure I'll have a couple questions down the road. Now to get Distance
working.

Thanks,
Scott
